Overview of full product suite: emr4MD, pm4MD, eRx4MD, patient4MD, rcm4MD, mu4MD. Key feature descriptions for each module.
4MD360 bundled product page describing the integrated suite. Confirms single database shared between EHR and practice management.
Core EHR features: customizable templates, Dragon dictation, Disease Management Engine, CDS, telehealth, auto eligibility.
pm4MD features: multi-location scheduling, auto charge capture, claims scrubbing, ERA posting, ClaimRemedi integration.
eRx4MD features: SureScripts certified, 55K+ pharmacies, drug interaction checking, PBM interface, DrFirst-powered.
patient4MD: secure messaging, appointment requests, refill requests, lab/radiology results viewing, C-CDA access, patient-submitted health info.
rcm4MD: full billing services including claims submission, ERA, A/R follow-up, workers comp/MVA specialists, monthly statements.
FHIR API page: read-only RESTful FHIR STU3 Ballot API, implemented via EMR Direct's Interoperability Engine. Last updated Dec 2023.
